ledger: Genuinely open profiling period; a permitted minor, approved electives or an internship plus electives under the 2026–27 regulations.
identity: Exact Dutch Media and Journalism route. The separate English Language and Media route is not a replacement for this comparison. Its year-one Discourse Analysis provides a control demonstrating the missing named module. The displayed Dutch allocation is 180 EC, not a verified progression pathway.
curriculumAndGates: Adopted 2026–2027 OER Article 9.1 and the exact annual course list require a pass in Discourse Analysis before Discourse and Social Interaction. The first course is in the English Language and Media route but is absent from the Dutch Media and Journalism allocation. The published Formuleren course overlaps in discourse methods, but its explicit use as an entry requirement is for Interactie in Organisaties. Article 3.7 allows an individual examination-board exemption, not a cohort rule. The provisional 2027–2028 recruitment list omits Discourse and Social Interaction and lists Digital Deception and Redactionele innovaties, without an adopted replacement, credits or cohort bridge. The shown allocation has 60 EC each year, including 30 EC open study and a 12 EC thesis and colloquium pair. OER 9.1 requires passing all first- and second-year courses for the thesis and colloquium. The Dutch diagnostic and any required remediation gate Academic Skills, and 42 EC plus the designated skills and language conditions apply to ordinary first-year study advice. Orientation and language requirements add no credits. Open study has approval and level rules. Workshops and practicals normally require 80% attendance.
officialAlternative: Checked the exact 2026–2027 annual course and Formuleren entries, adopted OER Articles 3.7, 9.1 and 15.2 and Appendix 1, and the official forward-year track tables. Formuleren is explicit preparation for Interactie in Organisaties, while the separate Discourse Analysis code still gates Discourse and Social Interaction. An individual prior-study exemption has a different scope. The 2027–2028 list omits the course but is explicitly provisional, without an adopted credit or progression bridge.
interestAccounting: 16 generator-eligible, 13 supporting and 13 search-only. Only the named social platform example is reclassified. Misinformation and data-driven changes are genuine programme themes. A future title alone does not create a separate option.
